pages.title: Tarpan
pages.text: The tarpan ($(o)Equus ferus ferus$()), or Eurasian wild horse, is an extinct horse that roamed the steppes and forests of Europe and western Asia.$(br2)Historical accounts describe it as a small horse with a mouse-grey to dun coat, dark legs and a dark stripe along its back.$(br2)Hunted and crossbred with domestic horses, it disappeared in the wild during the 19th century, and the last known tarpan died in captivity in 1909.
